def numoffbt(arr):

    import math
    
    # Count the frequency of each element in the array
    count = Counter(arr)
    
    # Sort the unique elements
    unique_elements = sorted(count.keys())
    
    # Initialize a dictionary to store the number of full binary trees ending with each element
    dp = {}
